name: hydronium-example-islands-tailwind
description: M1 proving ground for docs/HYDRONIUM_WEB_VITE_ADAPTER_PLAN.md: a real JS island (hydrate/dispose ABI matching examples/js_island/counter.js) importing a real npm dependency (nanoid), plus a Tailwind v4 CSS entry that scans a .luax file via an explicit @source directive. Deliberately standalone -- does not depend on @hydronium/dom-client or @hydronium/vite, both still M0 skeletons/M2+ work; this milestone only proves Vite 8 + Tailwind v4 themselves.
